audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Kennen five of seven rows (Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Skill, Kennen) while the prose concedes 4-5 to her E window, concedes first item to her tentacle field, and calls late a coin-flip.
audit.why: Packet reads Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Illaoi, Skill, Illaoi, Skill, and that is what whys[2] ('it evens out'), whys[3] ('this is her window'), whys[5] ('reclaim the duel') and whys[6] ('coin-flip') already say.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped as matched full/content pairs to Skill, Illaoi, Skill, Illaoi, Skill, with the full-layer ratings on those rows brought down from 8/10 so the numbers do not fight the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; 'trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range — a 16-second window at rank 1 is the entire lane rhythm, and it is a dodgeable skillshot. Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s leap with an auto reset, which is why she closes so fast once you are in her field. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s against your flat 120s R.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the 16s E, the 4s W and the flat 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The combo tell is missing: nothing on the page says her opener is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4s leap that resets her attack and makes nearby tentacles swing at the same target — the wind-up, not the cast, is the moment to step out. Against a 170-range Lightning Rush that timing is the difference between escaping and being tentacle-slammed.
audit.corrected: Named in breakdown.cooldowns as her leap and auto reset.

audit.why: The missing-interactions file claims Leap of Faith makes her untargetable, but Riot's text is only 'smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage... A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit' — no untargetability and no grounding. Both derived flags on that ability misfire, as the mirror also found.
audit.corrected: Nothing written on the strength of those flags.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. E-dash/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, a 900-range skillshot. Sidestep it and she has no kill pressure. - Harsh Lesson (4s): her leap and auto reset. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her window: a landed Test of Spirit makes you flee your own marked tentacles. Dodge the 900-range skillshot and she has no kill threat.

notes: The mirror's summary is ambiguous about which rows it moved ('Rows 2-5 -> Illaoi' could mean array indices or chart labels), so these rows follow the packet, which agrees with this page's own why-text on every row. See questionsForUser. Two derived flags on Leap of Faith (grounding, untargetable) contradict Riot's description and were not used; the packet's two suspectNames here are false positives — 'Test of Spirit' and 'Thundering Shuriken' are both correct, flagged on the preceding verb.
